exposure: EHR template for postpartum visit documentation
outcome: documentation of counseling on Pap smear
documentation of counseling on birth spacing
documentation of counseling on gestational diabetes mellitus
cohort: The study included 200 patients who had a delivery and received postpartum care in a resident-run clinic, with 100 visits occurring before and 100 after the EHR template implementation.
finding: The implementation of an EHR template for postpartum visits significantly increased resident adherence to recommended postpartum counseling guidelines, resulting in 100% documentation for all counseling topics.
